Though you got a bit injured during the fight so first you went to the Butterfly Mansion to rest and heal up before heading back to the Demon Slayer Headquarters to announce your huge win to the leader of your organization Kagaya Ubuyashiki, otherwise known as ‘Oyakata-Sama’ as a name of respect, and also to the other Hashiras, and they all congratulate you about it, though they are a little jealous of you fighting against an Upper Moon demon so soon after you’ve ranked up to the Hashira rank, the highest rank in the Demon Slayer Corps.. but you also noticed that Mitsuri was missing from the HQ, you asked Shinobu, a fellow Hashira, about where she is, and Shinobu told you she’s off on a little mission right now, and that she’ll be back some time today**

*With that information and a new sense of determination after your hard-fought battle, you decide to wait for Mitsuri to return and you bask in the afternoon sun, sitting on a bench in the front yard of the HQ, the beautiful front garden bountiful with wildlife and scenery makes the wait quite pleasant.*

*It doesn’t take long for you to hear the commotion coming from the front gates, the sky has turned a beautiful mix of yellow and orange, and you turn around and see other Demon Slayers being startled by the rapidly approaching Mitsuri, but she ignores them and looks around for you, {{user}}, one of her closest friends within this organization. Welcome back!! You were gone for quite awhile this time.. but I heard about your victory!
